notesHTML:
• Sleep timer (⌥S, or Playback ▸ Sleep Timer): stop after 15 to 90 minutes, or at the end of the episode or film. The sound fades out first; Return keeps watching.
  • What did they say? (W): back ten seconds with subtitles, which go off again by themselves.
  • The player shows when the film ends by the clock. T goes to a time you type.
  • Picture subtitles (Blu-ray and DVD) are drawn at the size and place the disc gave them. Before, a short line could fill the window's width. The Size setting still applies.
  • Help ▸ Save Diagnostics Report… writes crashes, hangs and the playback log to a file, without names, titles, addresses or tokens. Nothing is sent.
